command: apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-user-static && cp /usr/bin/qemu-x86_64-static /out/qemu-x86_64-static && dpkg-query -W qemu-user-static
scope: Install the distribution-signed emulator only inside a disposable local container to test an alternative x86-64 execution path; no host packages or product configuration are changed.
